alignments.note: Construct noun of the chain, taking only its own word.

Nomen rectum takes the chain's *of* (rule 19). Head moved to *peace*: שֶׁלֶם is the peace offering and *offerings* alone is any offering, which is the family rule 31 states for `עֹלָה` → *burnt offerings*. Heading on *offerings* was the competing reading, and it would need a bare *offerings* written for a same-class word in the verse or passage, which the ASV does not write here.
Prepositional predicate of a verbless clause takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 49).
Suffix takes the pronoun written for it (rule 18).
The article takes the demonstrative the ASV writes in the phrase's determiner slot (rule 41).
Finite verb with its auxiliary and subject pronoun, headed on the lexical verb (rules 17 and 24).
Construct noun takes its own word; the possessive stands on the suffix.

review_notes: Only the head of the שְׁלָמִים unit changed. Rule 31 lists `עֹלָה` → *burnt offerings* among the phrases headed on the modifier, and *offerings* here is the supplied generic; the edges of every unit are unaltered.
The margin's *Or, were due from me* was read and set aside; the printed *are with me* governs (rule 38).
